title: Rotate Array
contract: Rotate integers right by k ≥ 0 positions. Empty input remains empty.
brute: if(a.length==0)return a;k%=a.length;for(int turn=0;turn<k;turn++){int last=a[a.length-1];for(int i=a.length-1;i>0;i--)a[i]=a[i-1];a[0]=last;emit("Rotate right by one","array",a);}return a;
optimal: int n=a.length;if(n==0)return a;k%=n;reverse(a,0,n-1);emit("Reverse the whole array","array",a);reverse(a,0,k-1);emit("Restore order in the new prefix","array",a);reverse(a,k,n-1);emit("Restore order in the new suffix","array",a);return a;
reasoning: Repeat a one-position rotation k times after reducing k modulo n.
Write the array as AB where B has k elements. Reversing AB gives reverse(B)reverse(A).
Reverse the two pieces independently to obtain BA. Check the empty array before applying modulo and allow empty reversal ranges when k=0.
